courses.overview: 從弱點風險、相依圖與修補放行延伸至兩個相近領域；共用架構不代表相同數值、許可權或安全保證。
courses.overviewEn: Extend vulnerability risk, dependency graphs and patch acceptance to two neighboring areas; shared architectures do not imply equal values, privileges or guarantees.

related.title: 資安事件應變演練
related.why: 修補與應變都需資產與證據鏈
related.whyEn: Both patching and response need assets and evidence chains
related.transfer: 修補與應變都需資產與證據鏈
related.transferEn: Both patching and response need assets and evidence chains
related.difference: 修補為預防性變更，應變處理已發生事件
related.differenceEn: Patching is preventive change; response handles observed incidents

place.name: NIST 研究城市代表點
place.coordinateScope: 城市中心近似座標，僅作公開技術脈絡的地理代表點，不是機構地址、裝置位置、登入位置或參訪入口。研究與開源合作分散全球，並非本課所有技術都在此發明或部署。
place.coordinateScopeEn: Approximate city-center coordinates for public technical context, not institutional addresses, equipment, login locations or visitor entrances. Research and open collaboration are global; this does not locate every invention or deployment.

practice: 畫出本課與「資安事件應變演練」共用的資料／元件介面；以「修補與應變都需資產與證據鏈」指出能保留的條件。
針對「修補為預防性變更，應變處理已發生事件」改寫一個實驗，列出新增的輸入、單位與可辨別觀測。
將本課量化例移到新情境：沿用有根據的公式、重新指定假設並標記不能移轉的數值。
practiceEn: Draw shared data/component interfaces with cybersecurity incident-response exercises; use "Both patching and response need assets and evidence chains" to identify retained conditions.
For "Patching is preventive change; response handles observed incidents", redesign one experiment with new inputs, units and discriminating observations.
Transfer the quantitative example: retain justified formulas, respecify assumptions and identify nontransferable values.

courses.summaryEn: Software vulnerability-management workflows connects interfaces, data and acceptance through vulnerability risk, dependency graphs and patch acceptance. Maps are approximate public research-city references, not claims of manufacturing or deployment.

history.title: 從公開架構到原創教學模型
history.titleEn: From public architecture to original teaching models
history.text: NIST 修補指南將維護與組織風險連結；本課以合成清單重建判斷流程。
history.textEn: NIST patch guidance connects maintenance to organizational risk; this course reconstructs decisions with synthetic inventories.

history.year: 科教與協作 / Education and collaboration
history.title: 跨機構、跨版本的工程驗證
history.titleEn: Engineering checks across institutions and versions
history.text: 本課由原始檔案與官方介面出發，使用自製架構、算例和合成資料；城市標記只協助理解協作脈絡，不聲稱可參訪、可登入或具有現場操作許可權。
history.textEn: The course starts from original documents and official interfaces, using original architectures, examples and synthetic data. City markers provide collaboration context, not visits, logins or operational privileges.
